Kerala IT Department Renamed to Reflect AI and Deep-Tech Focus

The Information Technology department of Kerala has been renamed to reflect a strategic push towards Artificial Intelligence (AI) and deep-technology initiatives. This rebranding aligns with the state's technology vision, as announced in the Governor's policy address for 2026, which outlined the repositioning of the department. The change signifies a shift in focus for the department to embrace future technologies.
